answer: Identities grow on a shared vine: each newcomer joins a cohort of 8, every member locking 250 tokens into one pool. Expose a fake and the whole pool burns, plus mates lose 25% of rewards for 4 epochs. A plume of trust rises only after 10 clean epochs, while the tundra of unvouched agents earns nothing. Running 40 fakes means funding 40 pools, 10,000 tokens, and fooling 280 strangers, so fakery pays less than it costs.
